scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@studio/api & npm run dev --workspace=@studio/web
scripts.build: npm run setup:whisper && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.setup:whisper: rm -rf .render && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp.git .render/whisper.cpp && cmake -S .render/whisper.cpp -B .render/whisper.cpp/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DGGML_NATIVE=OFF && cmake --build .render/whisper.cpp/build -j2 --config Release && cp .render/whisper.cpp/build/bin/whisper-cli .render/whisper-cli && curl -L --fail --retry 3 https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-base.en-q5_1.bin -o .render/ggml-base.en.bin
